title: Design From Labs component sidecar (meta.json)
description: Gallery metadata for one component or foundation item in content/components/<source-id>/<name>/meta.json. Contract: docs/contract.md. The registry items themselves are shadcn registry-item.json files (schemas/labs-registry-item.schema.json).

schemaVersion.description: The contract version this file follows.

name.description: The slug. Must equal the directory name and be unique across every source.

description.description: One or two plain sentences. Shown on the gallery tile, the component page, llms.txt and the registry item.

status.description: The component's overall status. A variant publishes only when this is ready AND its own variants[].status is ready (docs/contract.md, section 3).

label.description: Optional collection label shown on the tile, e.g. "Labs examples".

variants.description: Every registry item of this entry, one per (style, primitive, icon set). Each needs items/<name>.json. Unimplemented combinations are simply absent; the gallery shows them as not yet available.

defaultVariant.description: The variant shown first; must be one of variants[].name.

demo.description: The gallery demo: a .tsx file (relative to the directory) whose default export renders the component with no props. Either one path for every variant, or a map whose keys are a variant name, a primitive (radix, base, aria) or "*" (fallback); the most specific key wins. Optional for foundation kinds.

preview.description: A compressed WebP or AVIF still in the directory, at most 200 KB, 1200x750 recommended. Optional for foundation kinds.

repo.description: A public https repository URL, or the literal "private source" for an approved private source (never a private URL or path).

commit.description: The full commit SHA the export or fetch was taken from.

path.description: Optional path inside a PUBLIC source. Omit for a private source.

license.description: An SPDX identifier on the redistribution allowlist (docs/contract.md, Licenses). scripts/check-licenses.mjs refuses anything else.

attribution.description: The notice the license requires to travel with the code (copyright line and license name). Required for every third-party component; the build prints it in each file's header.

credits.description: Source registry ids (docs/sources/registry.yaml) for everything this component uses or derives from: libraries, icon sets, references. At least one.

date.description: The date of the export or the last substantive change (YYYY-MM-DD).

a11y.description: Keyboard, focus, ARIA and motion notes, one sentence each.

usage.description: Optional short TSX usage snippet shown on the page and in llms-full.txt.

stage.description: Optional (contract revision 3). A layout part (sidebar, side panel, sheet, nav bar, toolbar, command palette, header, footer, tab bar) is shown in context: inside a neutral device frame and a skeleton app shell, in the given slot. Components only.

device.description: The device frame shown by default. The component page also offers desktop, tablet and phone.

slot.description: Where the component sits in the shell. Start and end follow the reading direction, so sidebar-start is on the right in right-to-left.

height.description: The default device's viewport height in CSS pixels, when the default is too tall or too short for the part (for example a footer).

kind.description: component (registry:ui or registry:block, the default) or a foundation item: theme (registry:theme), font (registry:font), base (registry:base), hook (registry:hook), lib (registry:lib). Foundations may omit demo and preview.

name.description: <component>[-<style>][-<primitive>][-<iconset>]: the primitive segment is omitted when primitive is none, the icon-set segment when iconSet is none. Examples: button-radix-lucide, badge-subtle-phosphor, tooltip-aria, designfrom-theme.

primitive.description: The headless primitive library: radix (the unified radix-ui package), base (@base-ui/react), aria (react-aria-components), or none.

label.description: Optional switcher label for the style, e.g. "Subtle".

status.description: Per-variant status. A variant publishes only when it is implemented and tested (ready) and the component is ready.
